editorial_thesis: The useful frontier is shifting from “can an agent do it?” to “can we measure, isolate, port, and govern the work?”

topic_groups.title: Agent Adoption + Outcome Measurement
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh GitHub telemetry turns agent adoption from prompt volume into feature-level, rolling-window evidence; this fills a measurement gap after yesterday’s spend and governance coverage.

topic_groups.selection_rationale: Vercel’s Harbor integration makes isolated, parallel agent trials practical; it is a concrete next step from recent evaluation-harness and safe-execution coverage.
